admin-workspaces-members-add.name: admin-workspaces-members-add
admin-workspaces-members-add.description: Add a member to a workspace. Super admin only.

admin-workspaces-members-remove.name: admin-workspaces-members-remove
admin-workspaces-members-remove.description: Remove a member from a workspace. Super admin only.

admin-workspaces-members-update.name: admin-workspaces-members-update
admin-workspaces-members-update.description: Update a workspace member role. Super admin only.

admin-apps-list.description: List all installed apps. Super admin only.

admin-apps-get.name: admin-apps-get
admin-apps-get.description: Get an installed app by ID. Super admin only.

admin-apps-create.name: admin-apps-create
admin-apps-create.description: Install/create an app instance. Super admin only.

admin-apps-update.name: admin-apps-update
admin-apps-update.description: Update an installed app. Super admin only.

admin-apps-delete.name: admin-apps-delete
admin-apps-delete.description: Delete an installed app. Super admin only. DESTRUCTIVE — use with caution.

admin-apps-get-access.name: admin-apps-get-access
admin-apps-get-access.description: Get agents that have access to an app. Super admin only.

admin-apps-set-permissions.name: admin-apps-set-permissions
admin-apps-set-permissions.description: Set permissions for an app (which agents can use it). Super admin only.

params.agentIds: List of agent IDs allowed to use this app

admin-access-list.name: admin-access-list
admin-access-list.description: List all agent-app access grants. Super admin only.

admin-access-grant.name: admin-access-grant
admin-access-grant.description: Grant an agent access to an app. Super admin only.

admin-access-revoke.name: admin-access-revoke
admin-access-revoke.description: Revoke an agent access to an app. Super admin only.

admin-catalog-list.name: admin-catalog-list
admin-catalog-list.description: List all available MCAs in the catalog. Super admin only.

admin-active-sessions.name: admin-active-sessions
admin-active-sessions.description: List active WebSocket connections in real time: total connections, unique users, and per-session detail (userName, userEmail, connectedAt, lastActivityAt, idleSeconds, connectionDurationSeconds). Admin only.

admin-usage-summary.name: admin-usage-summary
admin-usage-summary.description: Get overall usage summary (messages, tokens, costs). Super admin only.

admin-usage-by-user.name: admin-usage-by-user
admin-usage-by-user.description: Get usage breakdown by user. Super admin only.

admin-usage-by-workspace.name: admin-usage-by-workspace
admin-usage-by-workspace.description: Get usage breakdown by workspace. Super admin only.

admin-usage-by-agent.name: admin-usage-by-agent
admin-usage-by-agent.description: Get usage breakdown by agent. Super admin only.

admin-usage-by-model.name: admin-usage-by-model
admin-usage-by-model.description: Get usage breakdown by LLM model. Super admin only.

admin-usage-expensive-conversations.name: admin-usage-expensive-conversations
admin-usage-expensive-conversations.description: List most expensive conversations by cost. Super admin only.

admin-usage-timeline.name: admin-usage-timeline
admin-usage-timeline.description: Get usage timeline (daily/weekly aggregates). Super admin only.

params.startDate: Start date (ISO 8601). If omitted, returns all available data from the earliest rollup.
params.endDate: End date (ISO 8601). If omitted, no upper bound.

admin-usage-sessions.name: admin-usage-sessions
admin-usage-sessions.description: List agent usage sessions (paginated, newest first). Each session represents one LLM turn. Accepts filters (userId, agentId, workspaceId, provider, triggerKind, statuses) and pagination (limit, skip). Use format="otel" for OpenTelemetry-style output. Super admin only.

params.from: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.
params.to: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.
params.skip: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

admin-usage-session-detail.name: admin-usage-session-detail
admin-usage-session-detail.description: Get the full detail and chronological trace of a single agent usage session: the session record, its LLM calls, tool executions, message text, thumbs feedback, and direct sub-agents. Requires a sessionUsageId. Super admin only (conversation text is super-admin-only).

params.sessionUsageId: The session usage ID of the session to inspect. Required.

admin-model-health.name: admin-model-health
admin-model-health.description: Get per-model LLM health metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency + TTFT, error rate by kind, success rate, throughput) grouped by actual upstream provider × model. Accepts optional filters (userId, agentId, workspaceId, provider) and a time range (from/to as ISO dates). Super admin only.

params.from: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date, e.g. 2026-09-14T00:00:00Z). Required.
params.to: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00Z). Required.
params.provider: Filter by logical provider name (optional, e.g. "fireworks", "openai").
params.timeZone: Timezone label echoed in the response for client-side rendering (default "UTC").

admin-model-health-timeseries.name: admin-model-health-timeseries
admin-model-health-timeseries.description: Get per-hour health snapshots (p50/p95/p99 latency + TTFT, error rate, success rate, throughput) grouped by actual upstream provider × model, as a time series. Same scope as admin-model-health but returns one entry per time bucket instead of a merged figure. Accepts optional filters and groupBy (hour/day/week). Super admin only.

params.from: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.
params.to: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.
params.timeZone: Timezone label echoed in the response (default "UTC").

admin-upstream-errors.name: admin-upstream-errors
admin-upstream-errors.description: Get the most recent upstream provider errors (rate_limited, overloaded, server_error, spend_gate, auth_error, model_unavailable). Returns the error kind, sub-reason, and PII-scrubbed upstream message per session. Accepts optional filters (userId, agentId, workspaceId, provider) and a time range (from/to). Super admin only.

params.from: Start of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.
params.to: End of the time window (ISO 8601 date). Required.

admin-in-flight.name: admin-in-flight
admin-in-flight.description: Get a live snapshot of LLM streams currently in flight, per real upstream provider. Reads from the in-memory process gauge (not the database), so it is a point-in-time reading of this backend instance. Returns per-upstream counts, total, and a capturedAt timestamp. Super admin only.

admin-provider-status.name: admin-provider-status
admin-provider-status.description: Get a complete LLM provider health overview in a single call. Composes three backend actions (model-health, upstream-errors, in-flight) and returns: per-provider×model health metrics with classified status (healthy/degraded/down), recent upstream errors, live in-flight stream counts, and an overall platform verdict (green/yellow/red) with context. Parameters: periodHours (default 24), optional provider/model filters. Degrades gracefully — if one backend action fails, returns the rest with partial: true. Super admin only.

params.periodHours: Time window in hours for health metrics and error retrieval (default 24).
params.provider: Filter by logical provider name (optional, e.g. "fireworks", "openai").
params.model: Filter by model ID (optional, applied client-side on results).

admin-feature-flags-list.name: admin-feature-flags-list
admin-feature-flags-list.description: List all registered feature flags with their DB defaults and override counts. Super admin only.

admin-feature-flags-get.name: admin-feature-flags-get
admin-feature-flags-get.description: Get a single feature flag by key, including its current default value and all overrides. Super admin only.

admin-feature-flags-update.name: admin-feature-flags-update
admin-feature-flags-update.description: Update the default value of a feature flag. Super admin only.

params.defaultValue: New default value (boolean, number, or string)

admin-feature-flags-reset-default.name: admin-feature-flags-reset-default
admin-feature-flags-reset-default.description: Reset a feature flag default value to the code-defined registry default. Super admin only.

admin-feature-flags-get-overrides.name: admin-feature-flags-get-overrides
admin-feature-flags-get-overrides.description: List all overrides for a specific feature flag. Super admin only.

admin-feature-flags-set-override.name: admin-feature-flags-set-override
admin-feature-flags-set-override.description: Create or update an override for a feature flag. Overrides apply to a specific user, workspace, or company. Super admin only.

admin-feature-flags-delete-override.name: admin-feature-flags-delete-override
admin-feature-flags-delete-override.description: Delete an existing override for a feature flag. Super admin only.

params.targetType: Scope of the override to delete
